statements.statement: The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has recent episodes of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
There is concern for an underlying paroxysmal arrhythmia such as atrial fibrillation
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study is ordered
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
CPT code 93247 is medically necessary to detect paroxysmal arrhythmias associated with the patient's transient cerebral ischemic attacks and history of atherosclerotic heart disease
